title: Finite projection compatibility with normalized compactification comparisons
statement: For a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l, positive n and any specified finite operation stage S [def-sf-operation-stages], let f:X→Y be separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact. For any compactifications c,d, bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor constructible L on Y, the canonical component of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] intertwines S.finite.comparison f c d: tensoring its component at K with L and then applying PF_d equals PF_c followed by its component at K tensor f*L. There is no finite-Tor hypothesis on K and no separatedness hypothesis on the structure morphisms. Writing rho for that comparison, T for the partial tensor, and P_f for torPull S f, the equation is (rho_K tensor id_L);PF_d = PF_c;rho_(K tensor P_f L), where semicolon means composition in diagrammatic order.

proof.text: For a single proper refinement use the two endpoint realization equations to conjugate the ambient reverse refinement square of refinementProjectionCounit. Apply the faithful full inclusion; expand the actual component as sourceComparison, the realized fixedComponent, and inverse targetComparison. The private conjugate_square lemma cancels the endpoint isomorphisms. The middle equation is exactly the coefficient realization of the ambient counit projection equality. No projection component is inverted. This proves component_refinement_reverse.

Write the positive level as m+1. Choose a common refinement b of c,d. Apply component_refinement_reverse to both arrows. Cancel the invertible comparison on the second square to orient it forward; concatenate with the first square. The recorded comparison_trans equation identifies comparison(c,d) with comparison(b,c) inverse followed by comparison(b,d). Tensor functoriality and associativity give exactly the required square. All of this assembly is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem component_compactification
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn) :
    ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c d : Compactification f.hom.left) (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left),
      ((partialTensor S Y).map ((S.finite.comparison f c d).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          component S f d K L =
        component S f c K L ≫
          (S.finite.comparison f c d).hom.app
            (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L))
